scenes.tts: His central insight was almost mystical in its plainness. Drop a protein into water, unfold it with urea, wash the denaturant away, and the chain finds its way back to exactly one shape, every time, with no template and no instructions.
scenes.visual: portrait inset; central insight; protein dropped in water; urea unfolds; wash away; refolds to one shape every time; no template, no instructions
scenes.narration: His central insight was almost mystical in its plainness. Drop a protein into water, unfold it with urea, wash the denaturant away, and the chain finds its way back to exactly one shape, every time, with no template and no instructions.

scenes.tts: The shape was already written in the sequence, selected by the summed push-and-pull of hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic burial, and contacts with the surrounding water. He named it the Thermodynamic Hypothesis.
scenes.visual: sequence tiles; three contributions summed; shape selected; Thermodynamic Hypothesis
scenes.narration: The shape was already written in the sequence, selected by the summed push-and-pull of hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic burial, and contacts with the surrounding water. He named it the Thermodynamic Hypothesis.

scenes.tts: To the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in his 1972 Nobel lecture he put it as one sentence: "The native conformation is determined by the totality of interatomic interactions and hence by the amino acid sequence, in a given environment."

scenes.narration: To the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in his 1972 Nobel lecture he put it as one sentence: "The native conformation is determined by the totality of interatomic interactions and hence by the amino acid sequence, in a given environment."

scenes.tts: Later in life he went looking for philosophical structure, converting to Orthodox Judaism and becoming a fierce advocate for human rights. Colleagues said his method never changed: remove the denaturant, and see what refolds.
